groups.note: 食い違い: 苛性ソーダで磨いた日数を韓国語は3日（사흘）、英語は4日
diff: The Korean original says they scrubbed for three days (English edition: “four days”).

groups.note: 服を着たまま丸くなって眠ったことを英語は省く
唱えた4つの句のうち「腹が減っても注げ」を英語は省く
E30 の「出獄から1年」は英語の書き足し
diff: The Korean original says only that a year had passed, without saying from when (English edition: “A year after my release from prison”).

groups.note: E82 の「中に宿る涙の秘められた生」は韓国語では「中に宿る意味（뜻）」
E122 の「高すぎて買えなかった」は英語だけ
diff: The Korean original says only that in his heart he wished he could make him even some salted conch, giving no reason why he could not (English edition: “I wanted to give him salted conch, but this was much too expensive for us in those days”).
